Colombian President Poses with Body Bags in Social Media Video

Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella has drawn widespread criticism after posting a video on social media showing him walking among rows of body bags. The video, shared by his lawyer Abelardo De La Espriella, was presented as a show of force and a display of "performative populism." The president's actions have been described as provocative and have generated significant outrage.
